en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional. 'ми ги пејат ... книги старославни' I read as 'they sing for us from Old Slavonic books'; 'попој' is my reading of 'popovi' (priests).

lines.cyr: Ај смо шетале, мили мои мори,
lines.lat: Aj smo šetale, mili moi mori,
lines.en: Oh, we went strolling, my dear ones, hey,

lines.cyr: Гора, Света ле Гора, браќа мои.
lines.lat: Gora, Sveta le Gora, braḱa moi.
lines.en: to the Mountain, the Holy Mountain, my brothers.

lines.cyr: Ај там' видовме, мили мои мори,
lines.lat: Aj tam' vidovme, mili moi mori,
lines.en: Oh, there we saw, my dear ones, hey,
the church of Hilandar, my brothers.

lines.cyr: Ај, у црквата, мили мои мори,
lines.lat: Aj, u crkvata, mili moi mori,
lines.en: Oh, in the church, my dear ones, hey,

lines.cyr: Ај ми ги пејат, мили мои мори,
lines.lat: Aj mi gi pejat, mili moi mori,
lines.en: Oh, they sing to us, my dear ones, hey,
they sing to us, my brothers,
